scope: Small supplemental source review following GetCategorySalesAsync. Read ReportingQueryService expense/refund report bodies, endpoint dispatch, DTO contracts, write-side date/shift provenance, and existing integration-test source. No execution or shared report/registry edits.

reviews.behavior: AsNoTracking expense query; optional inclusive BusinessDate lower/upper bounds; optional shift filter applies only when nonempty; newest-first rows become ExpenseDto; TotalPiastres is sum of every filtered expense, regardless of drawer vs non-drawer source. The matching DateOnly overload delegates to a one-day BusinessDateRange (stable ID sym-add2d7f4da7babd1aef0de58f1af1f0850e7d939b890f480478c54f6c52e7c98, lines 121-122).
reviews.caller: GET /api/reports/expenses resolves businessDate/from/to and applies RequireReportsAccessAsync before service call (src/Falah.Server/Program.cs:2005-2007).
reviews.dto: ExpenseReportDto is TotalPiastres plus ExpenseDto list (src/Falah.Application/Reports/ReportingDtos.cs:18); ExpenseDto preserves amount, category, shift, PaidFromDrawer, payment account, creator, BusinessDate and CreatedAtUtc (src/Falah.Application/Expenses/ExpenseRequests.cs:16-18).
reviews.writer_crosscheck: AddExpenseHandler validates positive amount, requires existing open shift and open business day, builds protected-account movement, and stamps BusinessDate from BusinessClock.BusinessDate(now) while persisting the expense (src/Falah.Infrastructure/Expenses/AddExpenseHandler.cs:36-47,53-55,69-90,94-104). This supports use of expense BusinessDate instead of deriving report day from CreatedAtUtc.
reviews.test_evidence: ReportingVerticalSliceTests.Expense_report_totals_and_lists_every_expense_for_the_shift posts two drawer expenses and expects 5000 piastres and two rows (tests/Falah.Server.IntegrationTests/ReportingVerticalSliceTests.cs:111-121). BusinessDay_reconciliation_reflects_sales_expenses... also checks 3000 (lines 144-158). Tests do not cover non-drawer expenses, inclusive date bounds, empty shift ID, or sort order.
reviews.conclusion: No material defect identified statically. The report is an all-source management expense total, while DTO fields preserve source distinctions. A reader must not interpret TotalPiastres as drawer-only; existing endpoint name/report and DTO make no such narrowing claim.
reviews.counterevidence_and_gaps: The only dedicated report test uses drawer expenses; there is no direct assertion that a main-treasury expense is included. Source query does include it because no source predicate narrows rows. No runtime/database behavior was executed.

reviews.behavior: Converts optional business-date range to half-open UTC start/end; filters OrderRefund rows by CreatedAtUtc and OperationalShiftId when nonempty; joins the original Order for its number; returns amount/method/reason/actors/time and both OriginalShiftId and OperationalShiftId. DateOnly overload delegates single-day range (stable ID sym-d2f903e8b1a107f7c66046b49015f8b0bd60a6665ccce0193cef2001587abcb9, lines 141-142).
reviews.caller: GET /api/reports/refunds resolves businessDate/from/to and applies RequireReportsAccessAsync before the service call (src/Falah.Server/Program.cs:2009-2011).
reviews.dto: RefundActivityDto explicitly carries original and processing shifts separately (src/Falah.Application/Reports/ReportingDtos.cs:22-24).
reviews.writer_crosscheck: RefundOrderHandler resolves an operational shift, uses it on the refund treasury movement, and persists OrderRefund with original order ShiftId plus operational shift ID (src/Falah.Infrastructure/Orders/RefundOrderHandler.cs:95-110). This matches the report event-time and processing-shift filter semantics.
reviews.test_evidence: ReportingVerticalSliceTests.Refund_activity_reports_the_refund_with_its_order_and_shift_context posts a 5000-piastre refund, filters by the current shift, and asserts order ID and amount (tests/Falah.Server.IntegrationTests/ReportingVerticalSliceTests.cs:125-140). It does not test closed-original-shift/current-processing-shift split or event date differing from sale date.
reviews.conclusion: No material defect identified statically. Report correctly attributes the refund event to its processing shift and event time while retaining the original sale shift for audit context. Filtering by original-sale date/shift would misstate refund activity; source avoids that.
reviews.counterevidence_and_gaps: The integration test uses same original and operational shift, so it does not prove the cross-shift distinction. The report inner-join omits orphan refund rows; whether an orphan can exist depends on persistence constraints and was not investigated in this bounded batch. No runtime/database behavior was executed.
